observations: A large flat-fronted form fills the center, framed by a yellow-gold border stripe and a magenta-and-black banded header across the top third.
Two spiral shapes in light blue and orange-gold sit symmetrically in the upper half, each coiling inward around a darker core; a red cross-hatched oval occupies the left spiral.
Loose yellow circles outlined in black scatter across all four edges outside the inner border, while white zigzag and wavy lines layer over the lower central area.
reading: A dense frontal form holds the frame, its flat face divided by banded stripes of magenta, black, and gold. The two inward-coiling spirals—one carrying a red-crossed mark, the other a clean orange loop—sit above stacked zigzag bands and a row of white rounded shapes. Scattered yellow circles at the edges ring the whole composition, holding the patterned center in a loose enclosure that reads as both busy and contained.

connections.reason: Both works scatter yellow-outlined circles along all four edges as a repeating border element, though #71 fills its interior with many small oval faces while #72 concentrates on one large patterned form.
